rows.abstract: Proposes to add the following new section to Section 27, RA 6425 or the Dangerous Drugs Act of 1972: " SECTION 27-A. APPLICATION OF THE PROBATION LAW OF 1976. - NOTWITHSTANDING THE PROVISION OF PARAGRAPH (A) OF SECTION NINE OF THE PROBATION LAW OF 1976, ANY PERSON CONVICTED FOR THE FIRST TIME FOR VIOLATION OF SECTION EIGHT AND SIXTEEN OF THIS ACT SHALL BE PLACED ON PROBATION UPON HIS APPLICATION THEREFOR WITH THE COURT OF ORIGIN. HOWEVER, THOSE WHO ARE ALREADY SERVING THEIR SENTENCE MAY AVAIL OF THE PROVISIONS OF THIS ACT WITHIN ONE YEAR FROM APPROVAL THEREOF."

rows.abstract: Seeks to amend Article 390 of Ra 386, Civil Code of the Philippines, by declaring that after an absence of [seven] FOUR years, a person shall be presumed dead for all purposes; states, further, that the absentee shall not be presumed dead for the purpose of opening his succession until after an absence of [ten] FIVE years; states, likewise, that if a person who disappeared after the age of [seventy-five] SEVENTY years, an absence of [five] THREE years shall be sufficient in order that his succession may be opened.   * * *
